# SpikingPnPSolver

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spiking neural network architecture that solves the PnP optimization problem through iterative spike-based computations, replacing classical iterative solvers. Demonstrates that complex geometric optimization can be mapped to spike-based processing, expanding the scope of iNEST applications beyond simple classification.
